question: Which maps provider should this app use?

choices.label: No map — addresses as text only
choices.hint: The product stores and shows addresses without drawing them anywhere.

choices.label: Google Maps
choices.hint: Maps, Places autocomplete and geocoding. The most complete place data in most countries.

fields.label: Browser key
fields.hint: Google Cloud console → Credentials → an API key restricted to your domains. It is visible in the page by design; the restriction is what protects it.

fields.label: Server key
fields.hint: A second key, restricted by IP, used for geocoding on the server. Never send this one to the browser.

fields.label: Map ID
fields.hint: Map Management → your styled map. Optional; without it the map uses the default style.

choices.label: Mapbox
choices.hint: Vector maps you can style yourself, with a generous free tier.

fields.label: Public token
fields.hint: Account → Tokens. It starts with pk. and belongs in the page, restricted by URL.

fields.label: Secret token
fields.hint: A token with the geocoding scope, for server-side lookups. It starts with sk. and must never reach the browser.
